instruction: Treat guih07_steel_connection_seed.dxf in LibreCAD as the reference. Launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih07_steel_connection_seed.dxf`. Complete the hard structural steel connection. Draw STEEL plate rectangle (0,0)-(300,220), beam OUTLINE rectangle (80,35)-(220,185), CENTER axes (150,35)-(150,185) and (0,110)-(300,110), eight HOLE circles radius 7 at (50,45), (50,90), (50,130), (50,175), (250,45), (250,90), (250,130), and (250,175). Add WELD lines along (80,35)-(220,35) and (80,185)-(220,185) with small weld symbol ticks. Add text PL 300x220x12, 8X Ø14 BOLTS, and 6 FILLET WELD TYP. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih07_steel_connection_completed.dxf.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(10); pyautogui.press("enter")
